summary: You can carry scars of schooling or not even be good with words, it is meaning you need to play with and shape. the contours of context that scars contain can paint your pain. A second language and the apprehension caused by tenses, we can't pretend and make that go way. Instead, celebrate perspectives. Show students you can write in two languages
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You can carry scars of schooling or not even be good with words, it is meaning you need to play with and shape.
the contours of context that scars contain can paint your pain. A second language and the apprehension caused by tenses, we can't pretend and make that go way. Instead, celebrate perspectives. Show students you can write in two languages
